description: This PHP class extends a basic display field class to include aggregation functionality, specifically for generating SQL snippets with aggregate functions like MIN. It is part of the reporting module of the OrangeHRM system, handling display field configuration with aggregate operations.

classes.name: GenericBasicDisplayFieldWithAggregate
classes.description: A class that extends a basic display field to add support for SQL aggregation functions, facilitating reporting features in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the display field properties and specifies the aggregate function based on the display field's alias.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Returns the current aggregate function used (e.g., MIN, MAX).

methods.name: setAggregate
methods.description: Sets the aggregate function to be used (e.g., MIN, MAX).

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Generates the SQL select part incorporating the aggregate function, entity alias, and field name.
